title: VaultGemma Release
summary: Google's Gemma release ledger records September 13, 2025 as the release of VaultGemma in 1B parameter size. A Google Research post published September 12, 2025 introduced VaultGemma and stated that model weights were being released on Hugging Face and Kaggle alongside a technical report.
significance: A dated release milestone for a 1B-parameter Gemma-family language model trained from scratch with differential privacy.

verification.note: The release date follows Google's first-party Gemma release ledger. The separate September 12 Google Research publication is retained as an announcement/evidence boundary rather than substituted for the ledger's September 13 release date. No development geography, downstream influence, priority claim, or causal relationship is inferred.

sources.title: VaultGemma: The world's most capable differentially private LLM

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Google's first-party release ledger establishes a September 13, 2025 VaultGemma 1B release, while Google Research independently documents the model and its differential-privacy training properties.
